name: io.github.asopitech-labs/global-executables
title: Global Executables
description: Check whether a CLI command name is already taken across npm, PyPI, crates.io, Go, Debian and more

environmentVariables.name: GLOBAL_EXECUTABLES_DATASET_ROOT
environmentVariables.description: Optional local checkout of the dictionary branch; when unset, files are fetched on demand over HTTPS and cached

environmentVariables.name: GLOBAL_EXECUTABLES_CACHE_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Optional cache directory for fetched dataset files

environmentVariables.name: GLOBAL_EXECUTABLES_OFFLINE
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to serve only cached files and never touch the network
